objects.name: Analytic 2168
objects.description: Real-time monitoring of switch/router interface counters identifies a sudden spike in discarded or errored packets on an Industrial Control System (ICS)-facing interface combined with Central Processing Unit (CPU) utilization climbing above baseline, correlated with loss of reachability to downstream field devices on that segment within the same window. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when a device-specific traffic/resource threshold is exceeded and the same window shows service degradation, failed polling, device alarm/restart, resource exhaustion, or malformed/out-of-spec protocol behavior. Suppress planned load tests, maintenance, network convergence/failover, and known equipment faults after operator confirmation.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: netflow:ipfix
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: IPFIX/NetFlow flow record (src/dst IP, src/dst port, protocol, packets/bytes/time): flow volume to Industrial Control Systems (ICS) device subnet exceeds Denial of Service (DoS) flow threshold per minute

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: networkdevice:snmp
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: ifInErrors or ifOutDiscards rate exceeds baseline combined with cpu5min exceeding utilization threshold

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Network device CPU utilization percentage above which sustained load suggests packet-processing strain from flood traffic.
Connections-per-minute threshold exceeding normal SCADA polling cadence, derived from the device's actual configured scan rate.
Time window over which flood rate and subsequent device silence are correlated, typically 1-5 minutes.
Device-specific supervisory poll interval used to determine what counts as a process historian gap.
Deviation from baseline interface error/discard rate, tuned against historical interface health data.
Number of malformed/out-of-spec PDUs within the detection window constituting a flood, set above the device's documented error-tolerance baseline.
